The '''Stealth-2VX palm shooter''' was a small, spring powered [[dart shooter]]. Manufactured by [[Prax Arms/Legends|Prax Arms]], this weapon was the smallest known spring-loaded dart shooter, so small that it could easily be hidden in the palm of a Human hand or inside a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] or droid [[Droid caller/Legends|caller]].

==Design==
Manufactured by [[Prax Arms/Legends|Prax Arms]], the Stealth-2VX was among the smallest and lightest [[dart shooter]]s available.<ref name="EGWT" /> The body of the Stealth-2VX was designed to rest within the cupped palm of the wielder, while the weapon's three [[Dart/Legends|darts]] were positioned between the fingers.<ref name="AE" /> Because of its small size, the weapon was easily concealable, carried in a pocket or slipped up a sleeve. Some individuals disguised their Stealth-2VXs inside objects such [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] and [[Droid caller/Legends|droid callers]].<ref name="EGWT" />

The dart shooter could be loaded with three darts at a time, and it had a short range of up to four [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="EGWT" /> The weapon itself only weighed a quarter of a [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]], but came with a wristband that could be used to store an additional six darts. The combined weight of the weapon and the wristband was half a kilogram.<ref name="AE" />

==History==
The Stealth-2VX was generally employed as an emergency defense weapon, and its noiseless operation made it perfect for operations requiring secrecy and stealth, such as close-range assassinations.<ref name="EGWT" />
